records.name: Mental arithmetic estimation
records.definition: Estimate everyday quantities and check whether a numerical answer is plausible.

target_performance.statement: Mental arithmetic estimation: Produce a reasonable estimate before calculating exactly and identify estimates that are clearly implausible.
target_performance.metric: Produce a reasonable estimate before calculating exactly and identify estimates that are clearly implausible.
target_performance.conditions: Short, familiar arithmetic problems without time pressure.

steps: Estimate first; state the rounding used.
Calculate exactly or with a calculator.
Compare estimate and result; explain any large difference.
practice_protocol.environment: Use a calm, uncluttered and appropriately safe setting.

assessment.method: Give 10 varied everyday estimation prompts.
assessment.record: Store prompt, estimate, exact result and absolute/percentage error.

maintenance.trigger: After initial performance is stable, or when recall/accuracy declines.
maintenance.protocol: Use five mixed prompts weekly.

governance.status: All 20 records are DRAFT and require content review before approval.
governance.micro_skill_boundary: Micro-skills are small bounded capabilities linked to macro disciplines/skills; they are not part of the main CONTAINS hierarchy and do not roll up into macro-skill mastery.
governance.evidence: Use observable trials and recorded conditions; self-report alone is not demonstration. Do not infer safety certification.
governance.scheduling: Maximum planned session 30 minutes. Short practice must not displace sleep, recovery, protected obligations or core learning. Skipped items do not create an automatic backlog.
governance.safety: HIGH-risk records require explicit safety review before approval or scheduling. QUALIFIED_INSTRUCTOR_REQUIRED means practical competence must be learned and verified through an appropriate instructor/provider; ATHENA cannot certify.
governance.duplication: Link one canonical micro-skill to relevant skills/disciplines through SUPPORTS; use APPLIES_TO for contexts. Do not duplicate macro skill records.
governance.maintenance: Structured maintenance_policy is a provisional reminder model; mode=interval is computable, event_triggered/manual/provider_guided requires explicit user action or external guidance.
governance.skill_links_semantics: SUPPORTS only; links do not imply equivalence or mastery.
